name: Belial
source:
The continent's best mage (self-proclaimed) who descended to the capital to bring it to ruin.

He ressurects [url=https://vndb.org/c137175]Maya[/url] with the help of his "Necromancing" ability and takes her as his "dead girl" assistant.
